description: An immutable, traceable JavaScript grammar for building, revising, inspecting, and rendering charts through explicit graphical actions.
rules: Use Node.js 20 or newer and ECMAScript modules; CommonJS require() is not supported.
Start ordinary charts with chart().createCanvas().createData({ values }) and keep values as an array of plain row objects.
ChartProgram is immutable: assign or return the ChartProgram produced by each action instead of expecting in-place mutation.

Import from ggaction/basic only for creating and rendering scatter, line, bar, histogram, or heatmap charts; import from ggaction for editing, selection, composition, alternative coordinates, or statistical layers.
Render only after authoring: use render(program, canvasContext) in the browser, or the ggaction/svg, ggaction/png, and ggaction/pdf adapters for those outputs.
Use documented domain actions for normal chart authoring; use ggaction/extension primitives only when authoring custom actions.
Provide explicit resource IDs when multiple datasets, marks, scales, coordinate systems, or child programs make a target ambiguous.
Do not expect an automatic semantic-to-graphic compiler; each domain action materializes the graphics required by its semantic change.
